Queen City Songwriters Invitational 2026

Every song carries a story, and every story deserves to be heard.

18 writers · 12 rounds · 3 rooms · 2 nights at The Matthews

Right now in Spearfish

The rounds

One room at a time

A round is three writers taking turns: play an original song, tell the story behind it, pass. We run one room at a time, on the hour from 11 to 4 both days, so you can walk from one to the next and hear every round.

    The writers

    Eighteen writers

    Listed A to Z. Curated, not competitive. Tap a name for the story, the songs, and where to catch them this weekend.

      The rooms

      One walkable downtown

      The rounds rotate through three rooms, all in walkable downtown Spearfish. Both evenings are at The Matthews.

        The people behind the room

        We pay artists because their work has value. These partners, neighbors and funders are how we do it, and every name here stood behind original music in Spearfish this year.
